Jean François Ducos

[A French republican; born at Bordeaux, 1765; deputy to the Convention from the Gironde, and shared the fate of his colleagues, October, 1793.]
I hope the edge of your guillotine is sharper than your scissors.
While his hair was being cut off by the executioner. He also humorously remarked on the scaffold, “What a pity the Convention did not decree the unity and indivisibility of our persons!”—as it had of the republic.
